scene.text: Open Data Explorer | Season | Team | Side | Play type | /data-explorer: signed-in analyst. Preview, quality report and | source catalog have separate request states. |
Loading / Retry | Preview: loading | Source checks: loading | Clear the previous report or catalog. Show progress or a safe error | with Retry. |

Data and source status | Visible rows | Possessions | Data checks | Show preview filters/rows, source-wide pass/fail/not-run checks, | source row count and seasons. Checks do not prove model accuracy or | shot quality. |
Source details | Source details | Version | Pulled date | Expand to inspect the source SHA-256 and recorded pull date. A | missing pull date says Not recorded. |
Data Dictionary | Find column | Source filter | /data-dictionary: actual fields, meanings, units and source. Search | locally. |
Unknown or empty definitions | Undocumented columns | Matching fields | Show Undocumented column and counts, No matching columns, or Retry | for a failed request. Do not invent definitions. |
Choose inputs | Season | Our team | Opponent | Page filters | /shot-explorer (analyst), /shot-plan and /shot-heatmap | (analyst/coach). Select the page inputs. |
Run / Render | Run shot plan | Render heatmap | Capture the inputs. Hide old results and downloads immediately when | controls change. Ignore superseded responses. |

Current plan or preview | Top zones / Shot types | Points per attempt | Shot Plan waits for rankings and the image. Explorer shows rows; | Heatmap shows the plot. Plan ranks use points per attempt and | full-season samples; plot filters do not change them. |
Heatmap counts | Shot type | Zone | Max plotted shots | Show makes and misses as attempt counts. Reconcile matched, | plotted, invalid-location, outside-court and cap-omitted totals. |

Download current result | Export CSV | Plan PDF | Heatmap PNG | CSV/PDF use captured successful filters and current sources. PNG | additionally compares displayed source version and verifies echoed | inputs/counts. |
Failure / changed source | No data | Request failed | Source changed | Show no-data or retry error and hide stale files. PNG changed | source returns409; never download an error body as an image. |

Choose evidence page | Model Metrics | Shot Model Metrics | Shot Analysis | /model-metrics (including calibration): regular evidence; | /shot-model-metrics and /shot-statistical-analysis: saved shot | evidence. |

Load current evidence | Regular: computed diagnostics | Shot: saved five folds | Regular metrics compute diagnostics for the request. Shot pages | read validated saved five-fold artifacts without web training. Keep | metadata and result requests separate. |

Interpret current evidence | Training CV | Later-season holdout | Limitations | Show training versus later-season labels, missing values as | Unavailable, and visible retrospective or proposed-shot | limitations. |

Inspect technical details | Source versions | Sample support | Technical details | Expand source/sample details as needed. Historical uplift is | weighted modeled comparison, not held-out causal gain. |

Download permitted table | CSV | JSON | PDF | Saved shot metrics CSV | Regular Metrics shared report uses its displayed holdout table. | Shot metrics CSV uses its saved training-CV table and verifies | displayed source version. |

Unavailable / Retry | Unavailable evidence | Source/version mismatch | Clear stale evidence and disable export on loading/error. | Missing/stale saved artifacts require offline regeneration; Reload | only reads again. |
Select matchup and situation | Our team | Opponent | Season | Game situation | /matchup, /context, /gameplan and /context/quick-call: choose the | matchup and game situation. |
Build one snapshot | Score margin | Period | Clock | Coaching conditions | Use parsed numeric context and supported conditions on the first | Build. Overtime period5 accepts at most300 seconds. |

Show applicable result | Ranked plays | Applied and unused conditions | Context explains applied conditions and note-only inputs. Baseline | explicitly uses season aggregates without score/clock/period | effects. |
Change controls or scenario | Scenario controls | Old calls cleared | Immediately clear the old QuickCall list before debounce. | Cancel/invalidate its old request and capture the new inputs. |
Latest request completes | Current ranked calls | Matching request snapshot | Publish only a success whose snapshot matches current controls. A | late older response cannot replace a newer result. |

Error / unavailable | Retry | No stale calls | Error message | Keep failed refresh empty and show a retryable error. Core | readiness is separate from optional shot artifacts; no | response-time guarantee is implied. |
